abilitygroupdescription.p: These abilities represent training in the use of axes in combat. This includes the use of single handed war axes, two handed battle axes, and throwing axes.

abilitytrigger.name: Check
abilitytrigger.precondition: The character kills an opponent using an Axe Strike attack.
abilitytrigger.effect: Overflow damage + Rank is dealt to adjacent enemies.

abilitydescription.p: The character strikes at their opponent with great vengeance and furious anger. Damage from this attack beyond the amount that kills the target is then applied to all other targets adjacent to the attacker.

For example, suppose Dourli is attacking three goblin. He makes an Axe Strike attack on the first goblin with a righteous success and dealing 18 hit points damage to the goblin. The goblin only has 11 hit points. The overflow damage is 7.
When a character makes a frenzied attack with an axe, they make a Mettle Check. If they pass they may make another standard axe attack that round. On a bane the character goes beserk.

abilitycheck.name: Check
abilitycheck.precondition: Axe Strike Boon against an opponent carrying an item, a weapon or shield

mastery.critsuccess: Target drops item, weapon or shield. Attacker chooses.
mastery.success: Target drops random item, weapon or shield

abilitydescription.p: Characters equipped with an axe can use the axe to attempt to disarm an opponent or remove their shield by using the axes beard as a hook.
Characters equipped with an axe can strike with it during combat doing weapon damage.
